name: Sexy female ghost love me
source:
At midnight, a ghost in a red wedding dress enters Gu Yehan's villa. Their forbidden encounter, transcending life and death, tightly binds their destinies. Night after night, the ghost returns, weaving a tangled love story between life and death, filled with eerie romance and an inescapable fate.
